subject: gk
question: Article 163 of the Indian Constitution is related to which of the following?

options.text: Conduct of Business of the Government of a State
Council of Ministers to aid and advise Governor

solution:
The correct answer is __**Council of Ministers to aid and advise Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 74**: Council of Ministers to Aid and Advise the President.
 
• **Article 76**: Attorney General for India
 
• **Article 77**: Conduct of Business of the Government of India.
 
• **Article 78**: Duties of Prime Minister as a Head of the Government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 168 **Provides for the establishment of a Legislature in each State, which may be unicameral or bicameral.
 
• **Article 169** Empowers Parliament to create or abolish a State Legislature, which may be either a Legislative Council or Legislative Assembly.
 
• **Article 170** Specifies the composition of the State Legislative Assembly, which consists of representatives elected by the people.
 
• **Article 171** Details the composition of the State Legislative Council, including the method of election and appointment of its members.
 
• **Article 172** States the duration of the State Legislative Assembly, which is five years from the date of its first meeting unless dissolved earlier.
 
• **Article 173** Specifies the qualifications for membership in the State Legislatures.
 
• **Article 174** Grants the Governor the power to summon and prorogue the State Legislature and to dissolve the Legislative Assembly.
